title: Show bed: light (underscore)
description: Swung pizzicato in quarter notes (eighths in bars 16-21), a two-feel bass, soft taps and quarter-note hats; the major motif (F F C B A) on vibes every 8 bars. Underscore: the motif statements and lead lines are muted.
usage: The UNDERSCORE: the same bed with the motif and lead lines muted, for use under narration. Loops seamlessly (sample 0 to the end). -26 LUFS-S with a voice pocket at 1.25-2 kHz: duck it under Zoo's narration with scripts/audio/duck.py (the band-split duck, its default). Same tempo and key family as the other show beds: cross-fade between them on a bar line (every 2.667 s).
selfReview: The light show bed without the vibes motif statements, for use under speech (index 0.84 under Zoo with the band-split duck). See bed-show-light.
